title: Larry McKinley's half of a song and the Par-Lo mistake
summary: Matassa talked a company into giving Larry McKinley half a song for promotion that did not pay off; he lost about $300,000.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: The Dover, Dover records was for two. Uh, a guy I know in the business says, man, he says, you were crazy to, to send Robin on the road all that money. I said, what do you mean? He said, well, you know, he said, I ran across him in Baltimore. He says, and, uh, and he says, man, come on up to the hotel. He says, I got two bitches up there. That's more than I need.
